topic: The Universal Language of Exponents: Bridging Powers, Roots, and Logarithms

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Exponential Foundation
lecture_lines: Start with a base and exponent.
animations: Display text 'Base: b' in #FFFFFF at left. Color line 1.
Fade in exponent 'x' in #FFCC00 above base. Color line 2.
Animate result 'y' in #00FFCC to the right. Color line 3.

sections.title: Roots as Fractional Exponents
animations: Display radical sqrt(x) in #FF99FF. Color line 1.
Show conversion: sqrt(x) = x^(1/2) in #FFFFFF. Color line 2.
Highlight the exponent 1/2 in #FFCC00. Color line 3.

sections.title: Logarithms: Seeking the Exponent
animations: Display log_b(y) = x in #FFFFFF. Color line 1.
Highlight the x as goal in #FFCC00. Color line 2.
Flash b and y connections in #00FFCC. Color line 3.
Transition to log_3(81) = 4 in #FFFFFF. Color line 5.

sections.title: Visual Synthesis: The Transformation Map
animations: Show graph y = b^x in #00FFCC. Color line 1.
Show graph y = log_b(x) in #FF99FF. Color line 2.
Draw reflection line y = x in #FFFFFF. Color line 3.
Highlight intersection points in #FFCC00. Color line 4.
Fade in label 'Inverse Relationship' in #FFFFFF. Color line 5.

sections.title: Summary & Quick-Check
animations: Show summary table in #FFFFFF. Color line 1.
Highlight core link between forms in #FFCC00. Color line 2.
